evidence: Swap test fails: a GP surgery appointment booker or a library room booker could take the frame unchanged (pale grey-green ground, white bordered boxes, one green filled button, bold sans headings, outlined day buttons, time-tile grid); only the words would change.

Category-guess fails: the predicted council/government-service default (single column, red-bordered error summary titled 'There is a problem', step text list, institutional green) is what is rendered on every route.
Similar-prompt fails: 'slot booking for a council's household waste site in another town' would land on the same frame: tiles for times, Morning/Afternoon groups, white card summary, filled Next.

What is bound to this product is the copy only: 'the gate checks the reference and the vehicle', 'Starts DRC-, then five digits', 'Rubble (up to four bags)', 'DR-204117'. The masthead mark is a small generic bin outline beside the council name set in bold body text.
No signature: the slot grid is the category's standard pattern, and the done page reference DR-204117 is set as an ordinary heading in a white card rather than as something made for the gate.

unfinished: Identity is only 'Dunmore District Council' in bold body text next to a small bin outline; nothing else on any surface carries the council or the centre.

Done page (the Read surface shown at the gate) is two plain bordered boxes and an outlined button; the reference is a heading-sized line with no treatment; at 1280 an empty band of page ground sits below the footer (done default and cancelled, 1280-light).
Half-empty boxes at wide widths: 'Your booking' and 'Your reference' cards span about 1088px with content in the left third; the 'Opening days' card the same on the when page.
Slot grid stops at 7 columns (about 720px) while the page and the 'Opening days' card run to 1184px, leaving a ragged empty right half at 1280/1440.
Waste list is a stack of identical bordered rows with near-default checkboxes; vehicle choice is three plain outlined boxes plus an icon box.
Headings differ from body mostly by size and weight; no typographic moment anywhere.
evidence: root/slot-chosen/1280-light.png: first viewport is a heading, a grey paragraph, a step text row, four outlined day buttons and a field of identical tiles; nothing to look at beyond the task.
done/default/1280-light.png and 375-dark.png: 'Booked' heading, reference card, 'At the centre' card, outlined 'Book another slot'.
confirm/default/1280-light.png: full-width summary card with content in the left 350px; form column 610px.
Clean and orderly at every width, and dark mode is composed rather than inverted (root/slot-chosen/1280-dark.png), so it is plain rather than unappealing.
